summary: Add explicit, budgeted project-file questions with bounded local retrieval and exact source quotations.
decision_refs: The user requested a Trunk Tools-style ability to ask questions and answer from existing project files
Public Trunk Tools materials describe responses to user questions from project information; CIRP reuses only that public functional boundary
Ponytail requires reuse of the existing evidence, gateway, budget and viewer paths
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested question answering over existing project files.
known_limitations: This slice supports independent questions, not persistent multi-turn conversation history.
Retrieval is bounded lexical ranking rather than a vector index and has not been evaluated on customer construction questions.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer file, secret, live provider or paid model was used.
